highlights: Introduction : The video capture can capture both HDMI-compatible video and HDMI-compatible audio, sending audio and video signals to computers and for previews and storage.
Suitable for high definition acquisition, teaching recording, medical imaging, etc.
Support AWG26 HDMI-compatible standard cable: input up to 15 meters, (1080P and below resolution);
Support most acquisition software, such as VLC、OBS 、Amcap, etc;
Conform to USB Video and UVC standard;
Conform to USB Audio UAC standard; * Support uncompressed(YUY2 1080P@60Hz) acquisition (USB3.0);

No need external , compact and portable. HDTV video capture card, Audio and Video, - recording and play USB/USB C capture card, capture HDTV audio/video signals, Support devices with HDTV interface, such as: game consoles, computers, cameras, set-top boxes, etc 2
